purpose: Determine whether P0678's sole failed curl gate is caused by differentiating a potential-derived NIE field on the coarse 33-cell grid, without changing the P0678 threshold or recomputing any image root.
direct_evaluation_points: the P0678 33-cell strong-lens annulus points, evaluating NIE alpha at x+-h and y+-h rather than differentiating a sampled image

metrics.normalized_curl: RMS(d alpha_y/dx-d alpha_x/dy) / RMS(d alpha_x/dx+d alpha_y/dy)
metrics.derivative_stability: relative RMS difference in kappa and Jacobian determinant between the two smallest direct steps

selection_rule: Promote P0678's decomposition to a numerically qualified spent target specification only if every derivative-convergence gate passes. Otherwise retain the strength observations as provisional and replace the NIE derivative implementation before theory generation.
claim_boundary: P0679 audits a known analytic comparator and cannot validate any new gravity law.
Passing direct derivatives would qualify the P0678 decomposition numerically but would not make the compact halo a unique physical target.
Critical sign cells remain coarse diagnostics and no image roots are recomputed.
P0633 and P0640 sealed outcomes remain untouched.
